body:
This is related to how [garbage collection is intentionally suppressed](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/107579) by the engine. A proper C# API wouldn't have this problem. It's created by a design decision.

> The `CollisionResult` property in `ShapeCast2D` is simply a wrapper for `GetCollisionResult`, which allocates an array. Unlike GDScript which uses automatic reference counting, C# uses garbage collection which doesn't free memory right away and instead waits before sweeping a lot of memory at once. This leads to both climbing memory usage and performance spikes that don't happen in GDScript.

@Joy-less You're being silly here. Dotnet has a built-in reference counter that the engine sabotages. "Unlike GDScript which uses automatic reference counting" ... How do you think a garbage collector works?

It's not that the garbage collector is waiting around. The C# GC is intentionally disabled.
